name: Average Warthog 24
author: ercnersoy
description: Rounded sky-blue button that starts animating on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, border-radius becomes 30px 30px 0px 30px, box-shadow becomes inset 0px 30px 10px -25px #000000, starts the bounce42 animation (bouncing).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Average Warthog 24</title>
<style>
/* Average Warthog 24 by ercnersoy — https://uiverse.io/ercnersoy/average-warthog-24 */
button {
 padding: 20px 30px;
 border-radius: 30px;
 border: 5px solid #ffffff;
 background-color: #5584AC;
 font-size: 15px;
 color: white;
 letter-spacing: 5px;
 font-weight: bolder;
 animation: none;
 transition: all .5s ease-in-out;
 font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif;
}

button:hover {
 border-radius: 30px 30px 0px 30px;
 box-shadow: inset 0px 30px 10px -25px black;
 transition: all .5s ease-in-out;
 animation: bounce42 1.6s infinite;
}

@keyframes bounce42 {
 0%, 20%, 50%, 80%, 100% {
  transform: translateY(0);
 }

 40% {
  transform: translateY(-5px);
 }

 60% {
  transform: translateY(-5px);
 }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>BUTTON</button>

</body>
</html>
